verdict.rationale: The evidence shows CockroachDB changefeeds with at-least-once delivery and ordering guarantees, but nothing documents a registrable outbound HTTP webhook endpoint or sink that a programmatic consumer can subscribe to. Changefeeds are an adjacent event-streaming feature and do not by themselves count as webhooks under the standard used here, so this applicable axis gets no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
